target: A2.2 → stable B1+ on YKI keskitaso, official 4-skill outcomes evaluated independently
source_scope: No copyrighted lessons/videos copied; methods summarized/paraphrased and attributed in evidence register.
architecture_principles: Learner speaks/writes BEFORE model answer or transcript reveal
Separate perception and production and separate four YKI skills
Consent, delete/export for voice/writing and error history
All AI corrections uncertainty-aware, not official YKI grade
Optimize transfer/retention rather than time-on-app or superficial streaks
2026-10-21: New methods must prove delayed unseen gains, not momentary vocabulary recognition or motivational correlations.

modules.name_uk: Knowledge graph лексика → chunk → речення → задача
modules.input: content with source/rights and separate teacher review status
steps: Define typed graph IDs, versioned links and per-asset licenses
Enforce teacher-approved vs candidate-only visibility
Link a word to 2 distinct real-world productive contexts
acceptance: Every exposed task has provenance and license class
No FTB sentence marked teacher-approved by default
Repetition does not auto-mark all imported lemmas unknown

modules.name_uk: YKI real-life task engine з адаптивною зміною обставин
steps: Generate constrained real-life goal with expected communication outcome
No hints on independent attempt; reveal structured feedback only after user finishes
Require changing at least one situational constraint for transfer
acceptance: Every scenario has task-success criteria independent of grammar
Three consecutive practice attempts not counted as three unseen tests
AI turn cannot arbitrarily change role or add invented deadlines

modules.input: licensed audio + aligned transcript + questions + speaker tags
steps: Keep transcript & slow controls hidden on first scored attempt
On second attempt allow segment replay, show aligned evidence after response
Use different voices and new recordings for independent listening outcome
acceptance: No script-only dialogue scored as listening
0 inaccessible copyrighted audio cached without rights
List first-listen and assisted scores separately

steps: Separately mark relevance, register, comprehensibility, cohesion, grammar
Give learner 1–3 evidence-based hints instead of a completed rewrite
Blindly calibrate feedback against teacher anchors and track revisions
acceptance: AI never calls own numeric feedback official YKI grade
No complete rewrite counted as learner achievement
Each written sample can be manually corrected/deleted

modules.name_uk: AI voice tutor: task success, repair, uncertainty-aware ASR
steps: Listening-first or speaking-first mode, Finnish playback and manual transcript adjustment
Rate communicative accomplishment before grammar control
Separate AI feedback from teacher-anchored assessment; clear ASR uncertainty
acceptance: Accent/noise low-confidence responses abstain from precise phoneme punishment
Learner can replay audio and override incorrect transcript
Voice recording retention and deletion user-controlled

modules.name_uk: Finnish duration: perception vs production lab
modules.input: teacher-checked minimal pairs from different licensed speakers
steps: Create contrast sets e.g. tuli/tuuli and kuka/kukka
Randomize speaker and position; no answer leak
Record learner productions and compare by calibrated human or transparent acoustic measures
acceptance: Perception and production reported as distinct outcomes
Never infer quantity correctness from ASR text match alone
No phonetic visualization presented as exact forensic measurement without validation

modules.name_uk: Delayed recall на підтверджено проблемних конструкціях
modules.input: explicit unknown or verified production error
steps: Build scheduler with cold-start and change log, optionally benchmark FSRS
Store multiple sense/context uses, do not mistake recognition for productive recall
Repeat again under novel situational constraint after delay
acceptance: No bulk import of 10k lemmas into personal queue
Measure delayed recall and far transfer, not number of flashcards tapped
User can reset mastered state and export history
risks: FSRS optimized for cards not conversations

modules.name_uk: Four-skill independent assessment, teacher anchors, holdouts
steps: Maintain versioned unseen train/test separation and no model key leakage
Teacher double-rating before claiming calibrated level
Publish independent skill-level diagnostics with uncertainty and reasons
acceptance: Never combine four modules into one official YKI grade
Never present 0–100 product score as OPH grade 3 or pass chance
Thresholds/IRT not deployed without enough labeled learner responses

modules.name_uk: Цифрові вправи як підготовка до роботи на комп'ютері
modules.input: OPH published digital announcements & accessibility settings
steps: Create neutral timed text response, headphone and mic rehearsal
Validate each UI-specific behavior against new OPH rules as released
Provide accessibility safeguards and no surprise sounds
acceptance: No false claim of exact digital 2027 YKI UI
No hardcoded OPH-specific timer unless verified
Tech familiarity score separate from language proficiency

modules.input: consented anonymized attempt traces and held-out task bank
steps: Choose one hypothesis and predeclare primary endpoint
Assign baseline-matched users to tested intervention/comparator
Avoid interpreting novelty engagement as learning; publish limitations
acceptance: Measure independently checked outcomes and confidence intervals
Do not claim results before enough data
Telemetry opt-in; no raw personal voice or messages in public repo

modules.name_uk: Лінгвістична редактура контенту та експертні контрольні зразки
modules.input: draft learning content + copyright notice + teacher-review checklist
steps: Review word choice, punctuation, Finnish register, correct answers, acceptable alternatives
Review audio waveform and source transcript and speaker diversity
Separate corpus-candidate, synthetic and genuine human voice content in UI
acceptance: Unreviewed item excluded from strict scoring
All imported third-party examples retain provenance and transformed-credit notices
Unknown media rights block redistribution

experiment_backlog.question: Чи стимулює guided self-repair кращий незалежний B1 writing перенос, ніж показ повного AI rewrite?
experiment_backlog.control: full AI rewrite offered after first draft
experiment_backlog.primary_outcome: blind score on novel writing topic 7–14 days later

experiment_backlog.question: Чи покращує слухову самостійність segment evidence replay vs immediate full subtitles?
experiment_backlog.treatment: first listen → answer → targeted replay → evidence
experiment_backlog.control: first listen → immediate full transcript after answer
experiment_backlog.primary_outcome: new unaided first-listen comprehension score 7d later
experiment_backlog.secondary: inference accuracy and usage of hints

experiment_backlog.question: Чи покращують мінімальні пари з різними дикторами фінську quantity perception/production vs single TTS?
experiment_backlog.treatment: multi-human speaker contrasts + distinct production phase
experiment_backlog.primary_outcome: unseen quantity identification and blinded human production assessment
experiment_backlog.guardrail: one outcome cannot replace the other; explicit right-to-delete recordings

experiment_backlog.question: Чи зростає успішність задач під час адаптивного фокусу на індивідуальній помилці?
experiment_backlog.treatment: diagnose learner error → 3 targeted tasks → transfer
experiment_backlog.secondary: target grammar recurrence and learner load
experiment_backlog.guardrail: no automated false certainty or unsupervised teacher score

definition_of_done: All 11 modules remain proposals until shipped with working tests
No automatic score masquerades as certified YKI 3/4
Every training object has a license/provenance and review flag
Unseen benchmark separate from practice data
At least one delayed-transfer outcome for every learning intervention
Human-labeled teacher benchmark used before score calibration

new_evidence_workstreams.flow: 3–5 teacher-reviewed Finnish corpus examples → learner hypothesis → small contrast → unseen new sentence
done_when: All included examples carry CC BY credits and teacher acceptance
Alternative grammatical forms accepted/flagged instead of automatically wrong
Retest on unseen rektio after 7 days

new_evidence_workstreams.flow: Finnish chunk + accurate Ukrainian gloss + relevant image → active sentence → image-hidden delayed use
done_when: Licensed images or owned illustrations only
No effect claimed from card clicks
Active delayed recall measured separately from passive recognition

new_evidence_workstreams.flow: Draft → opt-in peer/teacher comments using semantic rubric → self repair → unseen solo writing
done_when: Consent and privacy controls for shared drafts
No peer corrections automatically considered authoritative
Final mastery checked on independent writing

new_evidence_workstreams.flow: Sketch reasons → say/write answer → one added problem → turn off scaffolds → independent response
done_when: Training planning time is not mislabeled as official exam prep time limit
No rehearsal prompt reused as unseen assessment
Coherence and task success tracked separately from grammar

new_evidence_workstreams.flow: Different licensed human speakers → quantity identification → optional audio-waveform visual comparison → human calibrated production
done_when: Do not use transcript WER as accent correctness
Human expert calibration and speaker consent
Separate perception and production score curves
